title: Ticket detail view with degraded dependencies
name: Ticket detail view

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code degrades when a downstream dependency is slow or failing? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
The knowledge base circuit breaker is OPEN while the ticket repository, CRM and SLA service are healthy. What does view() return?
choices: It throws CallNotPermittedException, because nothing converts the breaker rejection into a result for the whole view.
A TicketView with the real customer and SLA data, an empty suggestedArticles list, and "articles" in degradedSections.
A TicketView with suggestedArticles = null so the caller can tell the section is missing.
A TicketView, but only after kbTimeoutMs elapses, because the breaker only rejects once the timeout has expired.

questions.prompt: The CRM, knowledge base and SLA service all hang. Roughly how long does view() take to produce its result after the ticket is loaded?
choices: About 950 ms, because the timeouts add up one after another.
About 250 ms, because the shortest timeout cancels the other two calls.
About 400 ms, the longest single timeout, because the calls run concurrently inside coroutineScope.
It never completes, because withTimeoutOrNull does not cancel a hung suspend call.

questions.prompt: The ticket repository throws an IOException while loading the ticket. What happens?
choices: view() returns a TicketView with a placeholder ticket and all sections marked degraded.
The exception is caught in customerProfile and replaced by CustomerProfile.anonymous.
view() retries findById until the CRM timeout expires.
The exception propagates out of view(): the ticket is the core data, and only the three enrichment calls have fallbacks.
